output.summary: The yield drop is real: customer PPM rose and gauge R&R and CMM program are stable. New operators are exonerated, since they reject at the same rate as experienced ones and the decline began before they ran alone. Fatigue is unproven because scrap-tag times reflect batch tagging, not machining hour. Corvane bar spread and deferred spindle service are confounded: both changed in August and no machine has run one without the other. The Line 6 spare lathe and Tamsworth trials can separate them. Evidence is insufficient for a root-cause commitment. Prefer the staggered service plus trial lots and cycle-counter matching. Avoid blaming operators or cutting inspection.
